positive: The visible gallbladder region in a hepatobiliary ultrasound image.

F.summary: Segment the complete visible gallbladder region in hepatobiliary ultrasound, following its external contour and including its lumen and thin wall. Exclude surrounding liver tissue, separate vessels and bile ducts, kidney, bowel and background.

target: The segmentation target is the complete visible gallbladder region, including its lumen and thin wall.
appearance: The gallbladder is typically a dark fluid-containing sac surrounded by brighter hepatic tissue in hepatobiliary ultrasound, with variable shape.
boundary: Follow the visible external contour of the gallbladder sac separating it from surrounding liver and adjacent tissue.
exclusion: Exclude surrounding liver parenchyma, separate blood vessels and bile ducts, kidney, bowel, abdominal wall and ultrasound background.
domain_identity: Two-dimensional hepatobiliary ultrasound of the gallbladder.

policy: Fixed before first LUS model test; same source encoders; no prompt search
